body: FORMAL INDEPENDENT REVIEW — BLOCK cand-6ETEZ2X4434TZPKAV1RFT8GFHY at exact 12f846898e92ef68028ae64d747b5e6e1a9a093d. Passing evidence is preserved: clean isolated no-hardlinks clone; exact parent/base 6a3e804; declared grakern pin 0329c43; pinned model SHA-256 6fd5d72f... and tokenizer be50c362... independently rehashed; real embedOnnx/test 6/6 and embedBench/test 65/65; committed WOG report reproduced exactly; compileAll, scalafmtCheckAll, and scalafmtSbtCheck exit 0; review tree clean. The neural diagnostic numbers are therefore credible LocallyObserved evidence, not calibration or a default. The candidate is nevertheless not landable. First, the author self-hold is correct: BenchChannels.neural marks a trained neural provider NonMemorizing, invalidating the contamination gate. Second, lines 221-228 accept any Embedder[Id] and unconditionally assert NeuralEncoder; a HashedNgramEmbedder passed through this public facade compiles, runs, and renders neural-encoder. The scientific class is caller-selected, not derived from admitted provider authority. Third, Channel.identityChecksum at lines 72-80 hashes SemanticIdentity.render, while render at lines 40-41 truncates provider/query/document identities to 12 characters. Two distinct full ProviderFingerprint/GeometryId values with shared 12-character prefixes produce the same checksum (3b618e70b3624d125af90e9f77c41ac2f02640d28e45a5c97cad85062b0acf96), and report metric inputs consume that checksum at report.scala lines 245-247. A temporary two-property adversarial court compiled and failed 2/2 exactly on these defects, then was removed. Successor acceptance requires Memorizing neural exposure; a typed admitted-neural capability or sealed provider witness rather than a generic embedder plus asserted enum; canonical identity hashing over every full typed field, separated from truncated display; and committed mutation courts for lexical relabeling and shared-prefix identity collisions. Fresh exact-SHA evidence and review are required.
